fact: ELECAM put the voter register online at www.elecam.cm on 10 July 2025 so voters registered 2012-2024 can check their details by registration number or personal data and file claims; the list held 7,845,622 voters.
title: Présidentielle 2025/Cameroun : Le corps électoral convoqué, le fichier électoral disponible sur www.elecam.cm
